observation: Architecture critique R1 caught CRITICAL artifact id-resolution hand-wave (wrong table IDs for teamId, nullable agentId, no session linkage). Revision pinned exact resolution: body.agentId → users.teamId (=teamMembers.id, not tasks.teamId) → synthesize sessionId. This prevented 500-error (Agent not found) or cost mis-attribution bugs that would have manifested in green phase.

TDD red-then-green delivered: 18 failing tests written before code (AC1–AC5), all 31+32 tests green on first attempt. Zero mid-stream test rewrites, zero post-implementation fixes. Code faithful to pre-written contracts.

Honest AC4 scope narrowing: when 'artifact cost survives GET' contradicted 'no cost columns per O2', architect narrowed to 'recorded in aggregates + create response; GET intentionally NULL_COST per O2.' Narrowing is tested explicitly (T8b: GET returns NULL_COST AND bet aggregate persists), making it auditable forever, not silent.

Fixture-driven specification for AC3: instead of assuming CLI's total_cost_usd field name, plan required committed fixture before implementation. T6 owns fixture collection; T7 references it. Prevents guessing on external-tool behavior.

Schema reconciliation missing upfront: original plan didn't cite schema for users.teamId vs tasks.teamId. Architect assumed task had correct ids without reading nullable/FK targets. Critique pushed back: read schema.ts:162 and :167 side-by-side. Caught at Phase 2 (no shipped defect) but signals plan must reconcile schema if any column/FK named.

Critique loop R1 → R2 added ~4h but prevented 6–8h green-phase rework when wrong table ID and AC4 narrowing bugs would have surfaced in test failures. Critique loop ROI: sunk 4h to save potential 8h mid-implementation rework.

Code review found zero CRITICAL/WARNING findings on first pass. TDD + architecture critique payoff: by code review, big decisions locked and code fit-for-purpose. Dead cost_tick producer flagged as pre-existing (not AF10-introduced); AF11 authz vector explicitly routed out-of-scope.

Timeline: ~36h calendar (June 10 09:00–June 11 20:00), ~32h working. 8 commits: plan (1) → critique R1 (1) → revision (1) → critique R2 (1) → tests (1) → impl (1) → review (1). Sequential phases, no parallelization. First-pass green verify: 4099 unit + 2638 integration PASS, no blockers.
